rationale.consistency: Code naturally extends existing cloud API clients, matching idioms, naming conventions, and fake-server patterns flawlessly.
rationale.edge_cases: Perfect handling of 409 conflicts, HTTP request body rewinding on retries, context cancellation, and exact test abort error code mapping.
rationale.scope: Precisely targets the requirements; cleanly isolates the new provisioning flow while leaving the legacy v1 and PushRefID paths untouched as asked.
rationale.readability: Highly expressive comments, clean separation of concerns, and localized initialization logic (e.g. lazyInitProvisioning) make it very easy to follow.
rationale.robustness: Rigorous HTTP client lifecycle management, strong context checking during backoffs, and safe type bounds checking for archive sizes.
rationale.maintainability: Excellent testability via the dedicated domain fake server, modular HTTP clients, and safe extraction of shared configuration into clientcfg.
